data.body: Investigated: test asserts Phase 1.6b/git clone/captive strings in onboarding/SKILL.md. RED-marker tolerates the failure today (.test-index brainstorm/SKILL.md line). Fix path is binary: (a) implement the Phase 1.6b feature with the expected behaviors, or (b) delete the test. (a) requires knowing the intended UX of a captive-portal/network-check before git clone — needs user spec. (b) requires confirming the feature was deprecated. Either resolution requires user input; skipping in autonomous batch.
